---
name: New widget request
about: Suggest a new widget to be added to the widget set
title: "[NEW]"
labels: widget request
assignees: jaxparrow07

---

> **Anyone can suggest a widget, and you don't need to be a developer.** Only the first three fields
> are needed; everything marked *(optional)* can be left blank. This project only includes
> **macOS-style** widgets, so suggestions with no macOS counterpart are unlikely to be accepted.

**Widget name**:

**macOS / iOS reference**
Which macOS or iOS widget (or system feature) is this like? A screenshot or a link is enough.

**Why it belongs in this set**
What would you use it for, and why does it fit alongside the other widgets here?

---

**Widget type** *(optional)*: Desktop/Panel

**Widget category** *(optional)*: Clocks/Media/Calendar/Applets

**Proposed supported aspect ratios** *(optional, comma separated)*: 1:1, 2:1(wide)

**Are you planning to build it yourself?** Yes / No

**Design** *(only if you're building it)*
How it follows the [Design Guidelines](https://github.com/jaxparrow07/liquidglass-kde-widgets/blob/master/DESIGN.md): mockups, the 1:1 and wide layouts, and how it
looks in Glass and Solid, Dark and Light. Please wait for the request to be accepted before opening a PR.

**References** *(optional)*
Any extra images for the design, plus API documentation if relevant.

**Resources** *(optional)*
Anything that could be used inside the widget, such as icons or fonts.
